paper_style.palette_strategy: 主文和附录折线图主要使用珊瑚红/橙、绿色、蓝色、黄色和黑色虚线区分 MaxRL、GRPO、RLOO、rollout 变体与基线；Figure 1 以红/橙/绿表达解析权重函数；Figure 10 使用迷宫瓦片语义色；Table 4/6 使用青绿色标题栏和浅色底。表格结果依赖黑色规则、粗体和少量红色文字。多数数值图依赖颜色加少量 marker/线型，整体不灰度安全。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: 除 Figure 10 的迷宫示例含嵌入 RGB raster 外，折线、散点、直方图、箱线图和表格主要以 PDF vector text/path 渲染；pdfimages 仅在 p.1 页眉装饰和 p.44 迷宫示例处检测到 raster。PDF 字体对象包含 Computer Modern、SF/TeX 变体、DejaVu Sans/Serif、NimbusRoman、Inconsolata 等；没有完整公开的 paper-figure 导出源。
paper_style.style_consistency: 主文 pp.7–11 以跨栏小 multiples、共享 legend、Takeaway 框和紧凑表格组织 theory→result→mechanism；附录转为单栏，使用重复的 2/3/4-panel 曲线板、青绿色 hyperparameter cards 和少量示例图。方法身份的红/绿/蓝语义在相邻结果族内稳定，但不同 family 的 legend、坐标范围、采样单位和 caption 自包含程度并不完全一致。

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: (Maze) Motivated by Schaeffer et al. (2025), we record − log(pass@k) (lower is better) as a function of training rollouts for different objectives. We see that across all different inference rollout budgets (k), MaxRL exhibits better scaling compared to GRPO and RLOO as we increase number of training rollouts. Moreover, there is almost no gap in pass@k and pass@1 for GRPO and RLOO despite no repeated data, indicating that these algorithms may have lost the ability to improve further, whereas MaxRL has a substantial gap and potentially can improve more given additional compute.

figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5: (Qwen3 training results) Evaluation of final checkpoints from training Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-4B-Base, on 4 benchmarks: AIME 2025, BeyondAIME, MATH-500 and Minerva. MaxRL matches or outperforms GRPO in all 4 evaluation datasets and shows little to no degradation at coverage (pass@k) for very high k values. We also note the increase in inference efficiency: MaxRL can provide 2.3× - 19.2× speedup compared to GRPO while generating multiple samples with a perfect verifier and maintains similar or better pass@1 performance.

figures.label: Figure 8

caption.text: Figure 8: (ImageNet gradient norm analysis) Scatter plot, where each point has the pass rate (model’s predicted probability of the correct class) of a particular image in the x-axis, and gradient L2 norm for that image in the y-axis, for 1000 randomly selected images from the ImageNet validation dataset after 1500 steps of training on a ResNet-50 model. Sampling-based algorithms’ (MaxRL, GRPO and REINFORCE) gradients are calculated using 131,072 rollouts per example to reduce sampling error and estimate the population-level gradient. Cross-entropy and MaxRL have similar scatter plot: with high gradient norm for hard inputs (pass rate close to 0) and lower gradient norm for the easier ones (pass rate close to 1). In contrast, the highest gradient norm for GRPO is on medium-difficulty (pass rate close to 0.5) inputs, with hard inputs having very low gradient norm. Finally, REINFORCE fails to produce any significant gradient norm and its pass rate is confined below 0.003 after 1500 steps, demonstrating its difficulty to learn in this setting.

figures.label: Figure 9

caption.text: Figure 9: (Additional ImageNet results) On the didactic image classification setting, MaxRL outperforms and scales better than GRPO with additional compute, and approaches the same performance as maximum likelihood training via cross-entropy given sufficient number of rollouts (≥ 1024). Note that REINFORCE remains flat, since the initial model’s pass rate is low (∼ 0.1%) and REINFORCE fails to generate significant gradient signal (Figure 8). From left, the plots show pass@1, pass@128, Majority Voting Accuracy (equivalent to traditional validation top-1 accuracy in image classification, see Appendix H.3), and coverage of the final checkpoint, respectively.

figures.label: Figure 12

caption.text: Figure 12: (Training curves compared with other baselines.) We compare MaxRL with other RL algorithms, including entropy bonus, PKPO (Walder and Karkhanis, 2025), Differential Smoothing (Gai et al., 2026) and SELF (Nguyen et al., 2025b), under batch size 32 and number of training rollouts 128. figures.label: Figure 13

caption.text: Figure 13: (Effect of number of training rollouts in the GSM8K setting) For MaxRL, increase in number of rollouts N directly leads to an increase in the approximation order T of the maximum likelihood objective that the finite sample MaxRL optimizes. Here we compare the final checkpoint resulting from training with different values of T (= Number of rollouts) but otherwise identical training setup on the GSM8K setting. Increasing compute smoothly translates into performance gain, with the highest amount of gain for higher pass@k.

figures.label: Figure 14

caption.text: Figure 14: (Distribution sharpening over training on GSM8K) Evolution of the per-prompt pass-rate distribution on the SmolLM2-360M-Instruct GSM8K training set across 50 training epochs for MaxRL, GRPO, and RLOO. All three methods start from the same base-model distribution (epoch 0). As training progresses, GRPO and RLOO concentrate prompts into the two extreme bins ([0, 0] and [1, 1]), so the model either trivially solves or trivially fails most prompts and the intermediate bins are emptied. In contrast, MaxRL keeps probability mass spread across the entire pass-rate spectrum, gradually shifting weight from the failure end toward the higher pass-rate bins while continuing to expose intermediate-difficulty prompts to non-zero learning signal.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 与 Table 2 先把 MaxRL 定位为从 REINFORCE 到 maximum likelihood 的有限 T 权重函数；Table 1/Algorithm 1 将符号估计器落到实现。Figure 2–5 依次给出 exact-ML 控制、maze 数据充足、GSM8K 数据稀缺和 Qwen3 规模/效率主结果；Figure 6–7/Appendix H/M 解释梯度分配、非零信号、方差和 SNR。Appendix I/L/K 以完整训练曲线、替代 baseline、扩展 benchmark、majority voting 和模型动态补齐主文摘要，Appendix M 以 AIME solved-set、perplexity 与 non-binary maze 记录边界。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 主文 caption 通常以粗体 parenthetical title 开头，随后说明任务/设置、编码和一条主发现；Figure 1/2/5 等还直接写出理论或效率结论。附录曲线图延续同一 title→setup→comparison 模板，Table 4/6 用 hyperparameter card 标题，Table 10 与 Figure 30 则承担逐问题/轨迹级 evidence。大多数 caption 对不确定性保持沉默，除采样数、rollout 数或箱线图 marker 定义外很少给统计口径。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Table 1 采用 estimator/objective 的二层列组；Table 2 以四个 objective 公式为列；Table 3/5/8/9 使用 Method + 多个 Pass@k 列；Table 4/6 使用 Parameter/Value 双块；Table 7 在数据集列头中内嵌 majority@sample；Table 10 将模型、solved indices 和 solved count 对齐。表格普遍用 booktabs/部分规则、粗体 MaxRL 行和一位小数，但未统一把百分比单位写入每个指标头。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Table 1、Figure 1、Table 2 组成 method/theory interface；Figure 2 与 Appendix H Figure 8/9 给 exact-ML/control 对照；Figure 3/4/11–14 与 Tables 3/5 给 maze/GSM8K 结果；Figure 5/15–19 与 Table 7 给 Qwen3 scale、coverage、majority voting 和 training dynamics；Figures 20–26/Tables 8–9 做 PKPO、ZPD、Power Function ablation；Figures 27–29 检查 non-zero signal、baseline variance 和 SNR，Figure 30/Table 10 探索 capability proxy，Figure 31 探索 non-binary scope。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 主文 Figure 1–7 共 7 幅，Table 1–2 共 2 张；附录 24 幅 Figure 和 8 张 Table 覆盖每个主结果的训练轨迹、额外 benchmark、hyperparameter、baseline、统计诊断和边界扩展。主文显式指向 Appendix C–M 的证明与实验细节；视觉上最直接的调用是 Figure 2→H Figures 8–9，Figure 3→I Figures 11–12/Tables 3/8，Figure 4→J Figure 13/14/Table 5，Figure 5→K Figures 15–19/Table 7，Figure 6/7→M Figures 27–29。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文 caption 和表格主要沿用 Computer Modern/Nimbus-like serif；图内坐标、legend 和标题多为 DejaVu/SF-like sans，数学函数使用 TeX math fonts。Figure 1/5/14/15 和宽表在 A4 页上信息密度最高，字号约 6–10 pt；Table 4/6 的青色标题栏与其他表格的 booktabs 规则形成局部而非全局的视觉分层。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 红/珊瑚代表 MaxRL、绿代表 GRPO、蓝代表 RLOO/替代基线、黑色虚线代表 Base/Cross Entropy 的语义在主文及多数附录曲线中保持；rollout 变体和 ZPD/Power Function/PKPO 会引入橙、青、紫等局部色。颜色通常由 legend 与 marker/线型部分冗余，但灰度阅读仍会丢失方法身份；表格主要不依赖颜色，Table 4/6/10 的色彩更多是结构/强调。

most_reusable_patterns: 先用解析权重函数 Figure 1/Table 2 封闭 objective 差异，再用 exact-ML controlled plot Figure 2 建立可证伪的视觉基准。
用统一的 Pass@k small-multiple grammar 跨 data-rich、data-scarce、large-model 和 additional-baseline 结果保持阅读连续性。
把主结果的平均性能/覆盖曲线与 per-prompt histogram、gradient scatter、variance/SNR 诊断拼成 mechanism evidence chain。
将超参数卡、solved-problem index 表和 matched control boxplot 作为可复现/边界证据，而不是只给一个 aggregate score。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1 + Table 2：把 MaxRL 的 finite-T objective 与 RL/GRPO/ML 的解析差异可视化。
Figure 2：在能直接优化 CE 的 controlled ImageNet setting 中提供最清晰的主张对照。
Figure 5：把 Qwen3 两种规模、四个 benchmark、coverage 与 perfect-verifier efficiency 置于同一主结果矩阵。
Figure 14、Figure 28/29、Table 10 + Figure 30：分别覆盖 distribution sharpening、estimator noise 和 capability proxy 的附录证据。
failure_patterns: 多数曲线和表格只有 point estimates，没有 seed、重复 run、误差带或显著性定义；caption 的“significantly”因此超出视觉本身能支持的范围。
跨 panel 的指标、单位和 y 范围常变化，Figure 9 还把 gradient steps 与 k 混在同一 plate，增加比较成本。
颜色承担主要方法识别，且 rollout 变体色阶接近；灰度打印和小尺寸阅读会降低可辨认性。
speedup 标签、wide matrices 和 18-panel histogram 提高了信息密度，但计算方式、分母或采样不确定性没有总是写进对象。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 以解析权重函数和 controlled objective comparison 建立 MaxRL 的理论视觉主线，再用统一 Pass@k coverage 曲线、跨任务 small multiples 和附录机制诊断把“更多 rollout 改变目标”扩展到真实 LLM 训练，同时保留 binary/on-policy/finite-compute 边界。
